limits.connections: ENFORCED_IN_CODE: ConnectionBudget refuses a third connection
limits.disk_bytes: ENFORCED_IN_CODE: exact byte accounting with a reserve; no kernel quota is set by the package
limits.duration: ENFORCED_IN_CODE: monotonic, checked before every recv; recv timeout bounded by the remaining time (the live transport must honour it)
limits.memory: PARTIAL: RSS monitor in the runner + RLIMIT_DATA by the launcher; cgroup MemoryMax is NOT configured by the package
limits.message_size: ENFORCED_IN_CODE after receipt; the live transport must also bound BEFORE accumulating (max_size)
limits.messages: ENFORCED_IN_CODE: stops at the cap, message n+1 is never read
limits.planned_cut: ENFORCED_IN_CODE: monotonic clock, only after a healthy first session
limits.silence: ENFORCED_IN_CODE: monotonic since the last heartbeat (or session open)
